The new shares issued to Japanese investors are intended to raise working capital and fund operating expenses and capital expenditure.

The Japanese offering forms part of Anthropic's broader global IPO. In its October 26 registration statement filed with the U.S. SEC, the company identified Japan among the jurisdictions where it plans to conduct public offerings alongside Australia, Canada, certain member states of the European Economic Area, Switzerland and the UK.
The Japanese filing did not disclose the overall size or valuation of the IPO, according to the report.
